jei.simplecrucibles.info.soul_lava_bucke: Scoop a soul lava source: an iron bucket takes it but breaks when the soul lava is poured; an Enderite bucket never breaks. By default, soul lava is found in 0.5% of the Nether's lava springs and in the lava well of 10% of Nether fortress entrances. By default, a soul lava bucket burns 10 times as long as lava. These values are configurable; fuel changes require a restart. Above it a crucible gets extreme heat.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.copper_bucket_f: Scoop water or lava with a copper bucket. Pouring water only leaves a flowing block that runs off, never a source. Pouring lava breaks the copper bucket. A copper bucket cannot take soul lava.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.enderite_bucket: Scoop water or lava with an Enderite bucket: it holds two buckets of the same fluid. Use only scoops until it is full, then use pours one bucket; sneak + use pours one bucket at any fill. It comes back after pouring and never breaks.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.ceramic_bucket_: Scoop water or lava with a ceramic bucket; scooping does not wear it. Each pour wears it one stage, and the fourth pour breaks it. Burnt as furnace fuel, the ceramic lava bucket burns up with its lava.

A worn ceramic bucket moves one stage on each pour - intact, chipped, cracked, brittle - and keeps what it holds. The brittle bucket breaks on its fourth pour. Worn buckets cannot be repaired; fire a new one from clay.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.copper_bucket: Takes water and lava, never soul lava. Weathers while carried in the hotbar or off hand, or lying in the world or in an item frame (not in chests); fully oxidized it scoops nothing until scraped back. Honeycomb waxes it (in the off hand while holding the bucket, or used on an item frame): a waxed bucket does not weather. Filling a waxed bucket wears the wax, so it weathers at half pace until waxed again. An axe scrapes off the wax or one stage. Breaks when pouring lava.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.enderite_bucket: Takes water, lava, soul lava and milk (from cows, goats and mooshrooms), two buckets of one fluid, and never breaks. Pours soul lava into a reinforced cauldron, which then heats a crucible extremely.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.ceramic_bucket: Shape 3 clay balls like a bucket into a raw ceramic bucket and fire it in a furnace or crucible. The ceramic bucket takes water and lava (no soul lava, no milk), wears one stage per pour, and breaks after four pours; scooping does not wear it.
jei.simplecrucibles.info.enderite_crucib: With SimpleBuilding, hold a Netherite sledgehammer and Enderite nuggets in the off hand on a Netherite crucible and keep right-clicking: 12 strikes, every third strikes one nugget in (4 in all). A Netherite barrel takes two nuggets and twice the strikes of a furnace upgrade. The contents stay. 30 slots with double stacks, 8 times as fast.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.title: Simple Crucibles
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.r:
Cooking speed of the reinforced crucible, as a
multiple of the recipe's pace. The iron
crucible is always 1; the heat factor comes on
top. Default: 2. Range: 1–16.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.n:
The same for the netherite crucible.
Default: 4. Range: 1–16.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.e:
The same for the Enderite crucible.
Default: 8. Range: 1–16.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.f:
Cooking speed factor at medium heat (campfire,
soul campfire, magma block, flowing lava),
multiplied by the tier speed. Default: 0.5.
Range: 0.1–1.0.

The same at high heat (lava, lava cauldron,
flowing soul lava). Smelting and blasting
recipes need at least high heat.
Default: 0.75. Range: 0.1–1.0.

The same at extreme heat (soul lava, soul lava
in a reinforced cauldron). Default: 1.0.
Range: 0.1–1.0.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.t: Penalty: Heat Source Two Blocks Below

Slowdown when the heat source is two blocks
below the crucible (air, a hopper or a
non-full block in between). 0.1 = 10% slower.
Default: 0.1. Range: 0–0.5.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.a:
Seconds the iron crucible keeps its heat after
the heat source is gone. 0 = it cools down at
once. Default: 2. Range: 0–60.

The same for the reinforced crucible.
Default: 4. Range: 0–60.

The same for the netherite crucible.
Default: 8. Range: 0–60.

The same for the Enderite crucible.
Default: 16. Range: 0–60.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.n:
On: in the Nether every heat source counts one
level hotter, at most up to high (medium
becomes high). Off: the Nether heats like the
Overworld. Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.h:
Besides when a neighboring block changes, a
crucible looks for its heat source every this
many ticks (20 = 1 s). Higher = less server
load. Default: 20. Range: 5–200.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.v:
Weight of the field kitchen in each village's
houses pool; 3 is about every third village,
0 = no kitchens. Only villages generated
afterwards. Default: 3. Range: 0–10.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.c:
Damage per hit to a creature standing in a
crucible at high heat or more, like a magma
block (1 = half a heart). Not while sneaking.
0 = off. Default: 1.0. Range: 0–4.
text.autoconfig.simplecrucibles.option.s: Flow Reach: Overworld

How many blocks soul lava spreads sideways
from its source in the Overworld. Default: 2.
Range: 1–4.
Flow Reach: Nether

The same in the Nether. Default: 5.
Range: 1–7.
Flow Delay: Overworld (Ticks)

Ticks between two flow steps of soul lava in
the Overworld (20 = 1 s). Higher = slower.
Default: 45. Range: 20–200.
Flow Delay: Nether (Ticks)

The same in the Nether. Default: 20.
Range: 10–200.
Burning Time (Seconds)

Seconds a creature burns after touching soul
lava. Fire-immune creatures are spared.
Default: 30. Range: 5–60.
Soul Burn Duration (Seconds)

Seconds the Soul Burn effect lasts after
touching soul lava. Default: 120.
Range: 5–300.
Soul Burn Interval (Ticks)

Ticks between two damage rolls of Soul Burn
(20 = 1 s); on cold ground (water, ice, snow)
half as many. Default: 60. Range: 20–200.
Soul Burn Chance

Chance per roll that Soul Burn deals 1 fire
damage; fire resistance blocks it. 1 = every
roll. Default: 0.5. Range: 0–1.
Bucket Fuel Multiplier

Fuel time of a soul lava bucket as a multiple
of a lava bucket's. Clients need the same
value. Default: 10. Range: 1–20.
Nether Spring Chance

Share of the Nether's lava springs that become
soul lava when generated (0.005 = 0.5%). Only
new chunks. Default: 0.005. Range: 0–0.05.
Nether Fortress Chance

Chance that the lava well of a Nether fortress
entrance becomes soul lava (0.1 = 10%). Only
new chunks. Default: 0.1. Range: 0–0.5.

simplecrucibles.guide.page.1.title: Simple Crucibles
simplecrucibles.guide.page.1: Iron, Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite crucibles that cook every slot at once without fuel, barrels that dock onto them, the reinforced cauldron and village field kitchens.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.2.title: Crucibles
simplecrucibles.guide.page.2: A cooking station without fuel that cooks every slot at once, heated by the block below.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.3.title: Village field kitchens
simplecrucibles.guide.page.3: Villages of all five types can have a small field kitchen: an iron crucible on an unlit campfire with cooked food, a barrel of raw meat and a seat.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.4.title: Reinforced cauldron
simplecrucibles.guide.page.4: A cauldron for water, lava, powder snow and soul lava; lava in it heats a crucible like a lava source.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.5.title: Netherite and Enderite cauldron
simplecrucibles.guide.page.5: Reinforced cauldrons with room for 2 (Netherite) or 4 (Enderite) buckets of one content.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.6.title: Soul lava
simplecrucibles.guide.page.6: A rare Nether fluid and the only extreme heat source: it flows short and slow, is never replaced, and gives Soul Burn. Split stage 5b: was SimpleBuilding's, old worlds migrate.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.7.title: Copper and soul lava buckets
simplecrucibles.guide.page.7: Buckets for the crucible's fluids: the iron bucket breaks on soul lava, copper oxidizes. Split stage 5b: were SimpleBuilding's, old worlds migrate. The Enderite and ceramic buckets are Simple Tools';
simplecrucibles.guide.page.8.title: Copper and soul lava buckets
simplecrucibles.guide.page.8: with both mods the Enderite bucket takes soul lava and works on the reinforced cauldron.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.9.title: Recipe book
simplecrucibles.guide.page.9: Every craftable item of the mod is in the recipe book: picking up one of its ingredients unlocks the recipe.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.10.title: Creative tabs
simplecrucibles.guide.page.10: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).
simplecrucibles.guide.page.11.title: Commands
simplecrucibles.guide.page.11: /simplecrucibles config shows and changes every option of config/simplecrucibles-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simplecrucibles.guide.page.12.title: Commands
simplecrucibles.guide.page.12: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once; options read only at start say so. Permission level 2.
simplecrucibles.guide.page.13.title: Settings
simplecrucibles.guide.page.13: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
